note: StratMap statewide county-48 parcel MapServer lists the layer but refuses every query (Requested operation is not supported; spec validate fails on the query check). Madisonville_Parcels covers only the city of Madisonville (2,876 parcels), not the county. The Madison CAD viewers (BIS gis.bisclient.com/madisoncad, TrueAutomation mapSearch) expose no public REST service, and the TxGIO DataHub download was blocked (403). Third-party Madison County parcel files are paid, so not used.
